info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Hotel Rooms Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Cancellation API allows users to efficiently cancel booked hotel rooms. This endpoint facilitates the removal of reservations, ensuring that inventory is updated in real-time. Typical consumers include hotel management systems and travel booking platforms that require seamless cancellations. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance user experience and streamline their reservation processes.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows you to cancel a previously made room reservation. By sending a DELETE request to this endpoint, you can ensure that the reserved room is no longer booked under your name.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a room reservation. This operation requires the identification of the room to be cancelled and relevant details.

200.description: Cancellation successful; the room has been successfully cancelled.

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelRequest.description: A JSON string representing the body of the request to cancel a room reservation.

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Operation Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time in milliseconds for the cancellation operation.

message.description: A message providing more details about the cancellation operation.

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelResponse_200.description: Response object for a successful cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header allows clients to measure the performance of the operation.
